decisions.timeline: episode saved-frame order; pauses never reset history or transitions
decisions.no_success_label: observed reward=0; bootstrap remains gamma**8, even at cutoff; no fabricated +1 or failure terminal
decisions.half_definition: floor(original saved frames / 2); include observations [0, retained_frames), no action may cross cutoff
decisions.selection: fixed two source runs for half-prefixes; failure holdout includes one assisted and one policy-only failure; no critic-score selection
decisions.train_validation: explicit per-episode assignment; former _val/ep0 unobserved success moves to train
